title: ranunculus sceleratus subsp. multifidus
intro: Ranunculus sceleratus subsp. multifidus, commonly known as lesser celandine or pilewort, is a plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various skin conditions, such as eczema, acne, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of lesser celandine include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, promote tissue repair, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus sceleratus subsp. multifidus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
